subject: Onramp orchestration & GPU pool timelines for Dedicated/Private MAP
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Holt <claire@evantix.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp orchestration — proposed MAP milestones & GPU pool plan

Claire — following our call this morning I wanted to put a short, concrete proposal in writing so procurement and engineering have the same handoff view. Attached is a draft MAP (EVAN_MAP_v0.3.pdf) and a first-pass GPU sizing workbook. Key asks:

- Confirm target production start: 2027-09-01 (customer target)
- Confirm mix: Dedicated primary (80% traffic), Private VPC for regulated subset (20%)
- Preferred tranche approach: 2 tranches (pilot + full)

Why this matters now: Dedicated lead time for our preferred GPU pools is ~10–12 weeks for reservation + 4–6 weeks for staging; Private VPC on-boarding commonly adds a 6–8 week networking & compliance window. That sequencing affects the MAP milestones and signatures.

Next steps I propose:
1) Evantix to return acceptance on target start + tranche split by 5/21
2) Redwood to finalize reservation timeline and produce a one-page rollout schedule for procurement (we will include PST/UTC alignment)
3) Joint milestone review w/ engineering on 5/24 to validate staging windows

Attachments: EVAN_MAP_v0.3.pdf (38KB), gpu_sizing_model_evantix.xlsx (120KB)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the workbook line-by-line.

— Soojin

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful. Couple of clarifications from procurement/infra side:

- Target production start is still tentative; we are aiming for Sept 1 but procurement needs clear milestone dates to approve budget in June.
- The 80/20 split makes sense for our expected traffic; is Redwood able to stagger billing for the pilot tranche?
- For Private VPC we need a list of required IP ranges and onboarding checklist (security & network owners will need this).

Samir, please help confirm the internal budget approval timeline (we expect the procurement deck by 5/24).

Claire Holt

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp orchestration — proposed MAP milestones & GPU pool plan

Claire — quick note from ops: we can support staggered billing for pilot vs full commit. Practical timeline we recommend (based on current capacity and lead times):

- Week 0 (sign): Submit reservation request for pilot tranche (10% of projected concurrency) — lead time 10 weeks to guarantee the tranche on Dedicated clusters
- Week 6: Complete Private VPC onboarding prerequisites (KMS, peering, audit access) — parallel work by Evantix
- Week 12: Pilot ingress to staging (internal validation)
- Week 16–18: Pilot promotion cadence to production; initiate reservation for second tranche (scale to 80% concurrency) — second tranche lead time 8–10 weeks if placed at Week 16

I attached a short note 'dedicated_vs_private_leadtimes.docx' with common gating items. Two operational asks for Evantix to accelerate schedule: 1) provide a primary network owner and 2) finalize NDA addendum for private telemetry within 72 hours of signing.

— Priyom
VP, Technical Operations — Redwood Inference

Understood. We can commit to the tranche approach and will aim to:

- Confirm target start + tranche split by EOD 5/24
- Provide network owner (name + contact) by 5/26
- Procurement will request the budget sign-off deck on 5/24; Samir is owner.

Claire
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp orchestration — proposed MAP milestones & GPU pool plan

Claire — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a one-page orchestration timeline (also pushed to the shared Drive link) that aligns reservation windows to the MAP acceptance dates you provided. Highlights:

- If Evantix signs by 6/01, pilot tranche reservation request will be submitted the same day — expected Dedicated allocation confirmation by 8/10.
- We will open a Ticket-#RID-784 for Private VPC onboarding; expected network validation by 7/12 if Evantix provides owner on 5/26.
- Contingency: if the second tranche is requested earlier, we can prioritize but may bump lead time by 2–3 weeks depending on GPU family specificity.

Attachments: orchestration_onepager_evantix.pdf (12KB)

Next suggested steps: 1) Evantix to sign MAP (we can support DocuSign link), 2) Procurement to share budget approval doc on 5/24, 3) Redwood ops to open reservation request on 6/01. I can host the 5/24 milestone review (30m) to walk the orchestration one-pager and Jira tickets.

— Marcus Lin
Director, Product Operations — Redwood Inference
